absences.statement: The South Carolina State Election Commission's complete November 3, 2026 referendum list contains 42 local questions and no statewide constitutional amendments.

coverageNotes: The State Election Commission says an unfiltered Candidate Tracking search returns all candidates for the selected election. Both searches used all offices, all candidate statuses, all parties and all filing locations, with no county or name filters. Every Active candidate for each held contest is included from the full-territory official roster. Sources: https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22596 and https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22758

The official candidate-placement statement says: "In South Carolina, political parties are responsible for determining qualifications for their candidates and for certifying them for placement on the ballot in partisan elections." Source: https://scvotes.gov/placement-of-candidates-on-ballots-in-south-carolina/

The general-election roster contains all 124 state House districts and all seven U.S. House districts. The separate Special election selector lists SC Senate District 15 Special Election on November 3, 2026; its two Active candidates are included. Source: https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22758

The November 3, 2026 referendum search returned 42 Local Questions and zero Statewide Constitutional Amendments when checked. No statewide measure was listed. Source: https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/ReferendumSearch?electionId=22596
Governor and Lieutenant Governor are held as four joint tickets with each current running mate preserved from the official export. Incumbency and campaign websites are not stated in the export.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Official state-election-office root links its public Candidate Tracking portal, separately from the voter identity sample-ballot lookup.
Official Candidate Tracking introduction states the tracker includes all candidates who have filed; unfiltered election searches include the whole territory of every listed office.
Official election selector identifies election 22596 as the November 3, 2026 Statewide General Election.

Official statewide election search instruction says an unfiltered search lists all candidates. Available offices include every 2026 statewide office, U.S. Senate, U.S. House and state House, with no state Senate office listed.

All-candidate public search: ElectionId=22596, SelectedOffice=-1, SelectedCandidateStatus=All, CandidateFirstName=, CandidateLastName=, SelectedPoliticalParty=All, SelectedFilingLocation=All. Source row identifiers cross-check CSV ballot names and parties.

Official CSV export of all candidates for election 22596 (November 3, 2026); only Active entries are projected. Ballot-name fields, party and current running mate are converted without candidate transcription. The unfiltered official roster covers every selected contest's whole territory and contains every current Active candidate for it.
Official statewide election referendum search instruction says an unfiltered search lists all referendums; the StatewideConst filter is labeled Statewide Constitutional Amendments.

Official statement says political parties determine qualifications and certify partisan candidates for ballot placement. The full election roster records Active candidates and separately records rejected, withdrawn and defeated candidates.

Official Special election selector lists election 22758 SC Senate District 15 Special Election on November 3, 2026; its other 2026 entries are the September 1 primary and January 6 state House District 98 special election.
Official November 3, 2026 special-election candidate search for election 22758, State Senate District 15 (Unexpired Term).

All-candidate public search: ElectionId=22758, SelectedOffice=-1, SelectedCandidateStatus=All, CandidateFirstName=, CandidateLastName=, SelectedPoliticalParty=All, SelectedFilingLocation=All. Three source rows: two Active and one Defeated In Primary.

Official CSV export for election 22758 State Senate District 15 Special Election on November 3, 2026; two Active ballot names and printed party labels are projected. The unfiltered official roster covers every selected contest's whole territory and contains every current Active candidate for it.
